cohort: Pregnant women with expected delivery date between 2017 and 2019 and a second additional cohort of pregnant women with hypercalcemia between 2014 and 2016 and 2020 and 2021.
finding: Abnormal calcium levels during pregnancy are common and associated with worse pregnancy-related outcomes.
mod_finding: Both hypercalcemia and hypocalcemia during pregnancy were associated with an increased incidence of preterm delivery and emergency cesarean section.
